{{external|rs|rsc=Karamja Wolf}} {{HasTask|Wolves}} {{Infobox Monster |name = Jungle Wolf |image = [[File:Jungle Wolf.png|250px]] |release = [[20 August]] [[2003]] |update = New - Legends Quest! |members = Yes |combat = 64 |size = 2 |examine = A rare jungle wolf - specific to the Kharazi jungle. |xpbonus = 0 |max hit = 6 |aggressive = Yes |poisonous = No |attack style = [[Stab]] |attack speed = 4 |respawn = 90 |slayxp = 70 |cat = Wolves |assignedby = turael,spria,mazchna |hitpoints = 69 |att = 50 |str = 55 |def = 52 |mage = 1 |range = 1 |attbns = 0 |strbns = 0 |amagic = 0 |mbns = 0 |arange = 0 |rngbns = 0 |dstab = 0 |dslash = 0 |dcrush = 0 |dmagic = 0 |dlight = 0 |dstandard = 0 |dheavy = 0 |elementalweaknesstype = Fire |elementalweaknesspercent = 15 |poisonresistance = 0 |venomresistance = 0 |immunecannon = No |immunethrall = No |id = 232 }} '''Jungle wolves''' are a type of [[wolf]] found in the [[Kharazi Jungle]]. They only drop [[wolf bones]] when killed. If you get wolves as a [[Slayer]] assignment, you can slay these for the [[Slayer task|task]]. They are [[aggressive]] to all players and will start pursuing from a distance. They are similar to regular wolves, but the main differences are their colour and location. Their location in the jungle makes them hard to reach; if one plans to hunt jungle wolves, be aware that many other native animals are [[poisonous]], so be sure to have [[antipoison]]. ==Locations== {{LocTableHead}} {{LocLine |name = Jungle Wolf |location = [[Kharazi Jungle]] |levels = 64 |members = Yes |mapID = 0 |plane = 0 |x:2918,y:2927|x:2775,y:2913|x:2941,y:2887|x:2801,y:2899|x:2813,y:2917|x:2824,y:2896|x:2827,y:2924|x:2893,y:2893|x:2911,y:2894|x:2915,y:2906|x:2919,y:2907|x:2887,y:2929|x:2789,y:2932|x:2842,y:2899|x:2861,y:2907|x:2862,y:2899 |mtype = pin |leagueRegion = karamja }} {{LocTableBottom}} ==Drops== {{DropLogProject|jagex=yes}} ===100%=== {{DropsTableHead}} {{DropsLine|name=Wolf bones|quantity=1|rarity=Always}} {{DropsTableBottom}} ===Tertiary=== {{DropsTableHead}} {{DropsLine|name=Wolf bone|quantity=1|rarity=Always|raritynotes=Wolf bones are only dropped during [[Rag and Bone Man II]].|gemw=No}} {{DropsTableBottom}} {{Reflist|group=d}} ==Changes== {{Subject changes header}} {{Subject changes |change = Jungle Wolves now have a 15% [[elemental weakness]] to [[fire spells]]. |date = 25 June 2025 |update = Summer Sweep Up: Combat }} {{Subject changes |date = 4 June 2007 |update = Hair of the dog |change = The NPC was graphically updated. }} {{Subject changes footer}} ===Gallery (historical)=== {|style="text-align: center" cellpadding="15" |[[File:Jungle Wolf (historical).png|center|300x150px]] |[[File:Jungle Wolf.png|center|300x150px]] |- |29 March 2004 –
